ask_ai_block.description: AI responses don't appear as chat. They appear as greyed-out monospace text blocks ready to be typed over.

learn_from_scratch.description: AI course outline: modules -> lessons -> type-over blocks.

word_of_the_day.description: Displays word -> meaning -> 3 example type-over sentences -> user writes their own.

test_yourself.description: MCQ and short answer quiz format. Clean Shadcn elements.

profile_and_leaderboard.description: Displays XP, badges, streak, learning level, per-subject progress, and rankings in a dense, high-density grid.

subscription_page.description: Free vs Pro plan comparison, credit balance, AI usage % remaining. Premium luxury aesthetic for Pro tier.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism for floating Nav/Header (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0A0A]/60`). Neumorphism avoided. Borders: 1px technical lines (`border-white/10`).
visual_enhancers.noise: Subtle SVG noise overlay across the main background (opacity 2-3%) to prevent the #0A0A0A from feeling flat.
visual_enhancers.caret: Custom block or line caret that blinks at 1s intervals. When moving, apply a 100ms smooth transform to x/y coordinates.

motion.typing: Caret smoothly glides between characters instead of instantaneous jumping.
motion.ui: Staggered fade-in (100ms delay increments) for dashboard elements when loaded.
motion.focus_mode: When the user starts typing, the Header, Footer, and side UI elements smoothly fade to opacity-0 to create a distraction-free zone.

accessibility.contrast: Text over backgrounds meets APCA standards. Untyped text is #525252 on #0A0A0A (low contrast by design for typing apps, but correct text must be high contrast).
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` by disabling caret gliding and UI fade-ins.
accessibility.focus: High contrast yellow (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-yellow-500`) for all tabbable interactive elements.

image_urls.description: Monochrome 3D geometric shape with textured cubes

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The entire application must be heavily keyboard-navigable. In the typing sections, auto-focus the hidden input or capture global keystrokes so the user never has to click to start.

The Type-Over Engine should render text as individual `<span>` elements per character. Use classes `text-[#525252]` for untyped, `text-[#E5E5E5]` for correct, and `text-[#F43F5E]` for errors. The background must not have generic colored outlines.
Implement 'Zen Mode': As soon as a user types the first key, add a class to the outer wrapper that fades out the navigation, footer, and stats until they finish or pause for 2 seconds.
DO NOT use a traditional chat interface for 'Ask AI'. The answer must stream in as a type-over block that the user can immediately practice on.
Use `@phosphor-icons/react` for a technical, crisp aesthetic in the Dashboard. Provide installation command: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react
Never use `transparent` backgrounds for headers with scrolling content beneath. Use `bg-[#0A0A0A]/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-white/10`.
CRITICAL REQUIREMENT: The project is using .js and .jsx files, NOT .tsx. All your code guidelines, generated components, and imports MUST use standard JavaScript/JSX, not TypeScript.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute using kebab-case role-based formatting (e.g., `data-testid="login-form-submit-button"`).
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component are located in `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx`.
